name: パオーンファンファーレ
note: パオーンファンファーレ cast (パオーン隊長), facing RIGHT (mirror for left). Play 0->1->2, hold 2 while the shot flies, then 3, then return to paoon_right.png. Spawn the paoon_fx_shot anchor (22,16) at fxSpawn of the firing frame (the blast source: prop/mouth). fxSpawn = sprite-local pixel (frame coords, x right / y down, same space as the 32x32 frame) where the fx anchor goes; mirror x (31-x) when the attacker faces left.

frames.name: attack_0
frames.desc: brace: upper body pulled back 1px and raised 1px (the rest follows smoothly)

frames.name: attack_1
frames.desc: strike: upper body thrusts forward 1px - FIRE the shot here

frames.name: attack_2
frames.desc: hold: forward 1px and down 1px; hold while the shot flies

frames.name: attack_3
frames.desc: return: back in place (next: standing sprite)
